correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the LCF graph and all 1025 nonempty edge-matching faces directly. For all nineteen complexes, independently computed deterministic discrete Morse pairings and oriented every codimension-one incidence; topological sorting showed no cycle and exactly one zero-cell and b critical three-cells. Therefore integral homotopy types, not just finite-field ranks, follow by Forman; no symmetry inference substituted for an edge check.
